python -c "import transformers, torch; print(transformers.__version__, torch.cuda.is_available())"



pip install --no-cache-dir -r /mnt/code/tlone_app_v4/domino/env/requirements-tlone-tf4.txt
python -c "import transformers, torch; print(transformers.__version__, torch.cuda.is_available())"


cd /mnt/code/tlone_app_v4 && python -m pytest -q tests



dws-venv-export tlone-tf4
dws-venv-export tlone-tf5



dws-dockerfile-init


cp /mnt/code/tlone-tf4.yaml /mnt/code/tlone-tf5.yaml /mnt/dockerfile/desired-packages/


dws-dockerfile-create




/opt/conda/envs/tlone-tf4/bin/python -c "import transformers; print(transformers.__version__)"
/opt/conda/envs/tlone-tf5/bin/python -c "import transformers; print(transformers.__version__)"




/opt/conda/envs/tlone-tf4/bin/python -m pip install --no-cache-dir --force-reinstall --no-deps "transformers==4.57.1" "tokenizers==0.22.2" "huggingface_hub==0.36.2"
/opt/conda/envs/tlone-tf4/bin/python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r /mnt/code/tlone_app_v4/domino/env/requirements-tlone-tf4.txt
/opt/conda/envs/tlone-tf4/bin/python -m pip check
/opt/conda/envs/tlone-tf4/bin/python -c "import transformers, pytest, streamlit; print(transformers.__version__, pytest.__version__, streamlit.__version__)"



cd /mnt/code/tlone_app_v4 && /opt/conda/envs/tlone-tf4/bin/python -m pytest -q tests



dws-venv-export tlone-tf4
grep -i "transformers" /mnt/code/tlone-tf4.yaml
grep -i "transformers" /mnt/code/tlone-tf5.yaml



sed -i '1i name: tlone-tf4' /mnt/code/tlone-tf4.yaml
sed -i '1i name: tlone-tf5' /mnt/code/tlone-tf5.yaml
head -3 /mnt/code/tlone-tf4.yaml /mnt/code/tlone-tf5.yaml


cp /mnt/code/tlone-tf4.yaml /mnt/code/tlone-tf5.yaml /mnt/dockerfile/desired-packages/
dws-dockerfile-create
